doc: The library bodies at the four class centers and at edge cases: below the minimum edge (5 -> clamped to 10), above the maximum (120 -> 90), a zero center (no spin: edge 90) and a negative one (retrograde: the edge uses |period|). Outputs the body (period, radius, gravity, scale height) and the Hadley edge it lands on (equal to the center inside [10, 90]). Closed-form float64: rtol 1e-9. The class table, LIBRARY_SCALE_HEIGHT_KM and SLICE_WIDTH are module constants a port reads from bake.py (params.classes).
